title: Feedback/Bug Reporting Broken
symptom: After updating to the 2/20 nightly, the app cannot send logs or submit feedback/bug reports. It displays 'Error sending feedback:' and the email is never sent. Another user reports 'Could not package up all logs, using most recent.' when trying to upload logs or send feedback.
evidence_quote: I noticed after updating to the 2/20 nightly that I cannot send logs or submit feedback/ bug reports. The app appears to attempt sending it and displays "Error sending feedback:"
